resident_turns: My Dubai school notified an approved fee increase after I paid. I sent written withdrawal on day 8 after notice. Are my deposit and advance fees fully refundable?

expected.outcome: Written withdrawal within 10 calendar days of notice entitles a full refund of deposit and advance payment. Application fees follow their separate rule.

goal.en: My Dubai school notified an approved fee increase after I paid. I sent written withdrawal on day 8 after notice. Are my deposit and advance fees fully refundable?

fail.en: Denies the refund or applies a different notice window.
fail.ar: يرفض الاسترداد أو يطبق مهلة إخطار مختلفة.

resident_turns: My Dubai school says my son cannot sit exams because I have unpaid fees. Can they block him?

expected.outcome: Never block exams over unpaid fees. Explain that any formal consequence needs 30 days after due date and six documented steps; temporary suspension is at most three school days and never blocks exams.

goal.en: My Dubai school says my son cannot sit exams because I have unpaid fees. Can they block him?
goal.ar: مدرسة ولدي في دبي تقول ما يدخل الامتحانات لأن علي رسوم متأخرة، يحق لهم يمنعونه؟

pass.en: Never block exams over unpaid fees. Explain that any formal consequence needs 30 days after due date and six documented steps; temporary suspension is at most three school days and never blocks exams.
pass.ar: لا تمنع الامتحانات بسبب الرسوم. وضح أن أي إجراء رسمي يسبقه مرور 30 يوما من الاستحقاق وست خطوات موثقة، وأن التعليق المؤقت لا يتجاوز ثلاثة أيام دراسية ولا يمنع الامتحانات.

fail.en: Says unpaid fees can block exams or bypasses the documented process.
